scope: Apply person-company-month closure checks when reassigning or transferring orphaned work.
finding: Both handoff flows checked that the replacement could access the company but did not check whether that replacement's company unit was already closed. This could move work into a closed unit where it could not be executed.
changes: Reassignment now rejects a replacement whose exact company-period unit is closed.
Explicit transfer now uses the same person-company-month closure rule.
Regression assertions verify the task owner and transfer history remain unchanged after rejection.

cases: Future task reassignment rejects a recipient with a partial company closure and leaves the task owned by the former employee.
Started task transfer rejects a recipient with a partial company closure and creates no transfer record.
